dedupe_keys.name: benchmark dataset for hydraulic simulations of flash floods in the french mediterranean region

description: Université Gustave Eiffel and partners publish a French Mediterranean flash-flood benchmark through Recherche Data Gouv. It combines raw and processed terrain inputs, hydrographs, Floodos simulation results and validation observations for hazard mapping and three historical events: Argens 2010, Alpes-Maritimes 2015 and Aude 2018. Reference observations include flood extents, high-water levels and processed rating curves. Four public 7z archives and a JPEG guide are downloadable free under Etalab-2.0; internal file formats were not inspected. These materials can compare inundation models and test exposure estimates for roads, buildings and flood defences. The benchmark complements national river-gauge archives with paired inputs and reference inundation maps. Cinecar hydrographs provide event-specific forcing, while Floodos maps provide reference calculations, not independent measurements. Terrain errors, calibrated event inflows and the simplified steady-state hydraulic calculations limit transfer to other catchments or dynamic conditions. The rating-curve subset was screened and reformatted, so it differs from the original Hydroportail and BAREME records. Archive README files must be consulted before interpreting units or spatial resolution.
